subject: Shiny app deploys but not rendering plots or tables

messages.author: b70dd1baae36ae69
messages.subject: Shiny app deploys but not rendering plots or tables
parts:
I've recently created a shiny app and I am experiencing something odd where it runs fine locally however once it is deployed on shinyapps.io it does not render anything from one of the tabs. I've attached an image of what it looks like locally. The log is of no help and does not show a single error or warning just an expected print statement of the app doing its thing. What is extra strange is that a very small table renders in the first tab, but nothing in the second tab renders. Here is a link to the app itself (https://bkuenzi.shinyapps.io/EasyDRC/) as well as the github repo (https://github.com/brentkuenzi/EasyDRC). I'm running shiny 1.05 and RStudio Version 1.1.442.
